dse_runs.notes: Precision spec: max_abs_err <= 2^-20 (9.53674e-07) at >=50 MSPS; minimise luts_plus_ffs (select rule) and power_index. Tight error bound likely needs high data_width and/or many iterations; watch that throughput constraint is met. Explore iterative/unrolled/pipelined families broadly; prefer designs with margin on the error constraint since estimates are optimistic.

final_text: The campaign queue held a single spec, `high_precision` (coherent demodulator: `max_abs_err <= 2^-20` at `>= 50 MSPS`, minimising `luts_plus_ffs` with `power_index` as the second objective, selected by min `luts_plus_ffs`). I spent the entire 400-evaluation L1 budget in one `run_dse` call; the structured graph mapped the front three times and stopped with a single feasible, non-dominated design: `pipelined_m:data_width=27,n_iter=22,angle_guard=-1,frac_guard=0,rounding=round,m=7` at luts_plus_ffs=2314, power_index=4.35, luts=1908, ffs=406, throughput_msps=52 (all cost-model estimates, M1 calibration) and max_abs_err=9.53e-07 (exact golden-model value, exactly 2^-20.00 — on the constraint with only 2 MSPS of throughput margin). L2 `simulate_system` found no system scenario for this spec, returning only DDS facts (SFDR 144.6 dBc, SNR 130.3 dB, simulated) with the selection unchanged. The L3/L4/L5 ladder returned no measured data for this design — `verify_rtl` had no recorded row (a fresh exhaustive W=27 run is too heavy for a live campaign), `synthesize` had no recorded synthesis row, and `back_annotate` reported `no_measured_data`, so no winner change was flagged and `reexplore` was correctly not triggered. I finalized `high_precision` with that selection and its provenance noted; the memory write was refused because memory is switched off for this campaign.
